faqs.a:
Before any license shall be issued to an applicant pursuant to this chapter, each
               applicant shall file with the city clerk a cash bond, certified funds payable to the
               city, or a surety bond running to the city in the sum of $50,000.00. If a surety bond
               is provided, it shall be executed by the applicant as principal and at least one surety
               upon which service of process may be made in the state. The bond shall be conditioned
               such that the applicant shall comply fully with all the provisions of the laws of
               the city and the statutes of the state regulating and covering the applicant's business,
               and will pay all judgments rendered against the applicant for any violation of said
               laws or statutes together with all judgments and costs that may be recovered against
               him by any person for damage arising out of any such business with the applicant.
               Action on the bond may be brought in the name of the city to the use of the aggrieved
               person. Such bond must be approved by the city attorney, both as to form and as to
               the responsibility of the surety.
(Code 1981, § 23-7; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
